title: Gundam director says his new post-apocalyptic series was inspired by AI.
summary: Kamiyama Kenji said in an interview with Variety that Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO , releasing next year, is a metaphor for tech humanity is “already beginning to struggle to handle.” Can we truly master a technology we did not create ourselves…
